title: thelypteris glanduligera var. elatior
intro: Thelypteris glanduligera var. elatior, commonly known as the Elatior Thelypteris or the Elatior Lady Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris glanduligera var. elatior include reducing inflammation, fighting against bacterial infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
